_comment: Canonical voice IDs we use. Add new voices here, never hardcode IDs in scripts. Defaults are marked per (language, gender).

melissa.name: Melissa
melissa.notes: Default Spanish female. Use for UGC and conversational content.

fiona.name: Fiona
fiona.notes: Spanish backup. Use ONLY for educational or storytelling content — slow and deep delivery, not suited for UGC or conversational.

kazuha.name: Kazuha
kazuha.notes: Default Japanese female. Native JA delivery for series-a-jp. Library: https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library?voiceId=qbfQuoRJv1T3ei3qV4bc

salma.name: Salma
salma.notes: Default Arabic (Levantine) female. Native Arabic delivery for series-a-ar; use with model eleven_multilingual_v2. Library: https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library?voiceId=a1KZUXKFVFDOb33I1uqr

hanabad.name: Hanabad - Calm & Friendly
hanabad.notes: Default Korean female. Native Seoul delivery for series-a-ko; reads Hangul naturally (round-trip STT verified). Use with model eleven_multilingual_v2. Library: https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library?voiceId=YDseIkMzKtO5bK1Ehnev
